youtube.title: Krishna ne Govardhan ek ungli par kyun uthaya? 🏔️ #Shorts
youtube.description:
Vrindavan ke log har saal Indra ki puja karte the. Krishna ne unhe samjhaya ki hamara kartavya gaay, kheti aur Govardhan parvat ke prati hai, jo humein ghaas, jal aur anna dete hain. Gopon ne Indra ki jagah Govardhan ki puja ki.

Indra krodhit hue aur unhone saat din tak bhayankar varsha bhej di. Tab Krishna ne Govardhan parvat ko apni chhoti ungli par utha liya, aur sab Vrajvasi gaayon ke saath uske neeche surakshit rahe. Indra ka abhimaan toot gaya aur unhone Krishna se kshama maangi.

Katha ka strot: Shrimad Bhagavata Purana, skandh das, adhyay chaubees aur pachchees.
